All endpoints behind permission middleware: items_show (read paths catalogOverview/lastSummary/lowAlerts) + items_create (run) + items_edit on AvailabilityController toggle endpoints.

BranchScope: catalogOverview uses authorizeBranchScope($request, $branchId) to enforce caller can read the resolved branch. ItemBranchAvailability + StockLevel queries use withoutGlobalScope(BranchScope) BUT with explicit ->where('branch_id', $branchId) constraint = defensive (admin branchId=0 is short-circuited by 'if ($branchId <= 0) return empty payload').
No raw branch_id from query string trusted — branchId is resolved via scopedBranches($request)->first() as default.
No CSRF concerns on JSON POST (Sanctum cookie session).
No leakage in catalog-overview response: no internal ids beyond entity PKs, no PII, no fiscal data.
